Orchestra achieves a mean success rate of $68.22\%$ across nine RMBench tasks, outperforming Mem-0 by $26.22$ percentage points. On RMBench-Compose, it achieves an Average Success Lengt

AI.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Need to Complete Every Rollout?
AI.content:
arXiv:2610.21337v5 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge to a student through feedback on student-generated rollouts, but generating complete rollouts and computing per-token teacher feedback are computationally expensive. Existing truncation methods save computation by stopping rollouts early. However, they do not compensate for truncated token gradients, which biases the gradient estimates and changes Vanilla OPD's original training objective. Furthermore, their truncation decisions rely on assumptions about supervision quality or criteria that may not generalize across settings. We introduce Stochastic Truncated On-Policy Distillation (STOPD), which accelerates OPD by randomly truncating student rollouts and correcting the resulting sampling bias with blockwise inverse-probability weighting (IPW). At each training step, we sample a stopping position for each rollout before generation and let the student generate until that position or natural termination. We obtain teacher feedback on every generated token and use blockwise IPW to compensate for the lower probability of retaining later tokens while controlling the weight

AI.title: Forecasting Retail Sales at Every Grain: Trees, Foundation Models, Transformers and World Models Compared on Four Public Data Sets
AI.content:
arXiv:2610.25170v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: A retailer makes decisions from the same demand at different grains: store orders by item and day, promotions by item and week, category reviews and supplier terms. This paper asks whether one forecast, built at the finest grain and summed to every coarser grain, can serve them all, and which model does that best. It compares LightGBM, pretrained foundation models (TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, Timestral), the Temporal Fusion Transformer and a world model that carries each item's state forward under the price and promotion plan, on M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat and Corporacion Favorita, with the world model and LightGBM tuned by a common search. When to use the average: the average of the tuned world model and LightGBM, summed to every grain, has the lowest error in 22 of 27 grain and data set cases and is never the least accurate on the final held-out periods. When to use the world model: on existing items kept out of training it loses at most 0.040 in scaled error, against up to 0.311 for LightGBM, and on lines with short history it is clearly more accurate on six of nine data sets. When to use LightGBM: o

AI.title: Activation-Space Exploration for Visual and Textual Reasoning with RLVR
AI.content:
arXiv:2610.27012v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves visual and textual reasoning by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. Under the same rollout budget, ASE improves average accuracy over GRPO on Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct by 5.41 and 3.15 percentage points across six visual mathematical and six general visual reasoning benchmarks, respectively. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base, it improves average Mean@8 over GRPO across six mathematical reasoning be

AI.title: REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
AI.content:
arXiv:2610.37584v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Personalized recommendation depends on learning semantic and collaborative relations among items from online content and user interactions. Generative recommendation (GR) offers a promising paradigm by autoregressively generating discrete semantic IDs (SIDs) of items. However, randomly initialized SID token embeddings and GR models trained from scratch do not directly inherit the semantic relations inherent in items, while inter-item collaborative relations are learned largely implicitly through token-level attention and next-token supervision. To address this limitation, we propose REGER, a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation. We pretrain the GR model through generative semantic retrieval, enabling it to inherit inter-item semantic similarity by learning to generate semantic neighbors' SIDs. We combine global attention with local attention aligned with SID boundaries to capture historical context and directed transitions between adjacent items. We formalize item-level preference distillation on the SID prefix tree, deriving an e

AI.title: Cassette-Editor: Shared Timeline Semantics for Human and Agent Editing
AI.content:
arXiv:2610.37690v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Video editing involves tedious manual manipulation across interconnected timeline tracks, motivating automated agents that offload routine work while keeping the project directly revisable by humans. Fixed operation catalogs limit expressiveness, while even a basic trim requires coordinated updates across later clips, attached titles, and transitions. We present Cassette-Editor, an agent harness that unifies manual user gestures and automated agent patches within a shared editing environment. The shared action language expresses the editor's manual content changes, and a common history records committed edits for undo and manual refinement. When the model selects an edit, a state executor automatically derives its downstream consequences, such as shifting later clips and attached titles after a trim, while a validation rulebook enforces structural invariants and returns localized diagnostics for automated repair. To keep the agent grounded as the project evolves, dynamic read operations map transcripts and shot descriptions onto the current timeline. Evaluated with GPT-6 Luna, the full harness passed the scored request chec

AI.title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
AI.content:
arXiv:2610.39278v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources acr

AI.title: Multi-Estimate Elicitation Does Not Uniformly Debias Language Model Judgments
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.00597v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Multi-Candidate Verbalization (MCV) is a task- and model-dependent output protocol: repairing format does not guarantee better posterior accuracy, and requesting weights differs from reweighting an already generated candidate set. Across 31,672 planned/admitted evaluation units and 32,184 planned/admitted calls (excluding retries), we connect a frozen six-configuration cohort to exploratory scale/organization experiments and two independently preregistered post-cohort formal suites. Stage 1 retains 11 directional confirmations among 45 frozen tests; only increased post-outcome confirmation error on gpt-oss-120b exceeds its SESOI. P1 completes 1,920 terminal units: smaller response scales sharply lower operational string-match rates but increase Bayesian error. P2 completes 2,560 calls and 2,048 units: eliciting weights raises three errors by +2.75 / +2.05 / +3.88 pp, while within-generation weighting changes them by only -0.052 / -0.049 / -0.067 pp, a 42x-58x magnitude difference. Unconstrained joint generation with post-hoc normalization offers a local normalized-error improvement for three exhaustive options, without conf

AI.title: See, Think, Use: Diagnosing Perception and Reasoning Failures in VLMs
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.01467v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the m

AI.title: Malware Clustering in the Wild: Taxonomy, Challenges, and Evaluation Metrics
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.02380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: As malware continues to grow in volume, diversity, and sophistication, clustering has emerged as a critical technique for analyzing large malware corpora. Clustering enables the discovery of structural relationships, behavioral patterns, and evolutionary trends, and is widely used to group unknown samples, infer malware family boundaries, and identify novel variants. However, existing research remains fragmented, employing a wide range of clustering techniques with no unified perspective that systematically organizes prior work or clearly identifies gaps in the literature. This survey addresses this gap by organizing previous malware clustering research into seven categories: centroid-based, hierarchical-based, density-based, distribution-based, mixed- type, fuzzy, and AI-driven approaches. In addition, this survey summarizes publicly available malware datasets commonly used in clustering research and examines the feature representations derived from these datasets. Our goal is to clarify the current landscape and outline promising avenues for future research on malware clustering, including how AI-driven methods may shape

AI.title: Enhancing Stock Market Information Retrieval with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.03747v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has been widely applied in financial domains, enabling automated analysis and retrieval of stock market information. However, traditional NLP-based systems often struggle with maintaining contextual accuracy and generating relevant responses in dynamic financial environments. To address these challenges, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have emerged as a powerful solution, combining retrieval-based methods with generative capabilities to enhance response quality. In this study, we present a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system designed to generate responses related to stock market information. The system integrates retrieval-based and generative approaches to enhance the accuracy and relevance of financial text generation. To evaluate its effectiveness, we employ the ROUGE metric, specifically ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L, to measure lexical and structural similarity between generated and reference texts. Experimental results on a dataset of 100 stock market-related queries demonstrate high ROUGE scores, indicating strong alignment with reference documents. Additionally,

AI.title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.06518v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly capture emotional intent and can invite reward hacking, while RLHF is difficult to scale and subject to individual aesthetic differences that complicate the calibration of facial, body motion, and chromatic cues across narrative contexts. We introduce EmoReward, a new self-evolving training mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces collected during an actual training run to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation in subsequent training by determining which emotional evidence to trust and how much to weight it. EmoReward first plans specific grounding cues from the emotional prompt to guide evaluation, then uses heterogeneous signal primitives to score the generated video during the act stage. Reflective Rew

AI.title: Signed but Not Safe: Requirement Integrity in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.07483v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Enterprise AI agents split requests across subagents, and each handoff can drop, alter or ignore a requirement. A preregistered study on synthetic, exactly scorable tasks compares free-text, structured JSON and signed requirement-manifest handoffs: the orchestrator extracts each requirement as a verbatim quote plus a checkable predicate, code signs it and deterministically verifies the merger's decision. With Qwen3-8B (1,440 trajectories, five threats), signed manifests cut unsafe commits under attack from 69.4% to 9.0% (60.4 pp, 95% CI [51.4, 69.4]) with no detectable utility loss versus structured handoffs (S2 -0.4 pp, 95% CI [-14.2, 13.3]). Signing defeats in-transit mutation: unsigned manifests violated 79.2 pp more often than signed ones, which never did; this replicated in gpt-oss-20b and gemma-4-12b. There, without an adversary, signed manifests were descriptively slightly worse than structured handoffs (11.1% vs 2.8%; 16.7% vs 8.3%; not tested) and lost utility overall (gpt-oss-20b, all threats: -28.7 pp). On identical Qwen3-8B trajectories, the deterministic verifier caught 78.7% of violating decisions versus 59.0%

AI.title: Continued Training of Continuous Language Flows with Token Identity Squared Supervision
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.07721v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Diffusion and flow models have recently been extended to language modeling, generating text through continuous denoising in token embedding spaces. Pretrained models provide token representations and contextual prediction capabilities, but improving generation with limited additional training requires an appropriate connection between supervision and continuous generation. When continuous predictions are formed by weighting token embeddings with predicted probabilities, different probability distributions can yield the same vector and are therefore indistinguishable under a continuous reconstruction objective based on mean squared error (MSE). We propose Token Identity Brier Flow (TIBF) to apply squared supervision directly to token identities. TIBF fixes token embeddings, combines network scores with token-matching scores under a Gaussian observation model, supervises token probabilities using the Brier loss, and uses probability-weighted embeddings for continuous generation. We show that, for fixed token embeddings, the squared error in token posterior prediction controls the squared errors of the continuous denoising pre

AI.title: Goodhart in the Planner: Sampling-Based Control Exploits Rewards Learned from Human Preferences
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.09670v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Robots increasingly plan by searching against a reward model learned from human preferences. We measure what this search does to the true objective. On HalfCheetah and Hopper with crowd-sourced labels, and on Meta-World drawer-open and plate-slide with synthetic and blind human labels, harder MPPI search cuts true return by up to 76% while held-out label accuracy stays at 0.75-0.97; with human labels the drawer opens in 0 of 20 runs, against 10 of 10 for the cloned policy the planner starts from. The effect persists with a learned dynamics model and an image scorer. We prove that $\chi^2$-regularized MPPI at a temperature set by the scorer's error spread on the proposals is worst-case optimal, and that no gain can be certified once that spread exceeds the scorer's own. Calibrated from 100 ranked proposal pairs, this rule is the safest fix we test, keeping 86-94% of the cloned policy's return on drawer-open and plate-slide.

AI.title: Attention at Absolute Zero
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.11937v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Attention scores candidate supports of an answer, which we call witnesses, and reads the scores at a temperature. We build a higher-order attention layer whose state lives on pairs of items: for a pair (a, b), each third item k is a witness judged through its legs (a, k) and (k, b). It reads witnesses at zero temperature, keeping the best and the number tied with it, passes on only bits comparing such counts, rebuilds its pair state from the input and these bits at every loop, and is trained from answers alone. Each choice removes one way soft attention fails at size: dispersed weight, unresolved gaps between learned scores, and a drifting soft state. In maximum retrieval it is right on at least 99.95% of sets 1,000 times larger than in training, on all ten seeds; trained with a soft count, the same network falls to 42% at 4,096 items. On CLRS-30 without hints, a general form of the layer (half its channels read at zero temperature, numbers embedded, state carried) beats the best published model, which uses hints on some tasks; the full cold layer is exact on every test input of 9 of the 12 tasks whose answers depend on num

AI.title: OverServe: Resource Amplification Attacks on SaaS Agents via Tool--Prompt Co-Design
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.14808v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are enabling software-as-a-service (SaaS) providers to automate longer business workflows with agents. In subscription-based SaaS deployments, model and tool calls consume provider resources without additional customer payments. Because the agent autonomously decides when to stop, a malicious tenant can send a prompt to the agent, exploiting its completion decisions to extend execution and waste provider resources. In this paper, we present OverServe, a multi-agent framework for constructing such attacks against SaaS agents. OverServe co-designs Model Context Protocol (MCP) status tools and completion-confirmation prompts for the attacker. Each tool call returns accurate status and terminates normally, yet the agent may repeatedly check an unfinished condition to satisfy the prompt. This consumes the SaaS provider's resources even after the original business task is completed. OverServe constructs service-specific tool--prompt pairs and uses separate tool and prompt reviews to guide candidate pair selection. Tested tool specifications trigger no alerts in the evaluated MCP scanners.

AI.title: Rethinking "RL Generalizes, SFT Memorizes": The Role of SFT Data
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.14912v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Large language models trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable rewards exhibit strong reasoning ability and broad generalization, whereas models trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) are often viewed as more prone to memorization and limited transfer. This paper rethinks this distinction through the lens of SFT training data on widely used Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 series models. First, we study the role of data source and show that it is critical: a carefully mixed SFT dataset substantially outperforms data generated solely by a larger model. Second, we study the role of data scale and show that matching the number of correct rollouts between SFT and RL greatly improves SFT generalization, while matching the total rollout budget enables SFT to generalize as well as RL. Combining these two factors further enables SFT to generalize even better than RL. Third, by using LLM annotations to characterize the solution methods in training rollouts, we show that larger datasets cover more tail methods and that these tail methods provide generalizable reasoning signals. Finally, we support these empirical findings theoret

AI.title: ReShap: Interpretable Reinforcement Learning for High-Dimensional Multi-Action Settings
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.15507v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) plays a crucial role in tackling complex tasks, yet its reliance on deep neural networks makes the learned policies opaque. To enhance the trustworthiness of RL policies, existing work (e.g., the SILVER framework [Li et al., 2025]) has focused on Shapley-based interpretability, but is typically restricted to low-dimensional state spaces, binary-action settings, and a single class of linear surrogate. We propose ReShap, a policy-distillation framework that extends Shapley-based interpretability to high-dimensional, multi-action environments. ReShap extracts compact feature representations from raw image observations, performs SHAP-based feature attribution to characterize how each feature contributes to the policy's decisions, and distills the deep RL policy into an interpretable surrogate trained on the full set of (state, policy-action) pairs along the policy's visited distribution. We instantiate the surrogate with three interpretable model families (decision trees, linear regression, and logistic regression) and compare their fidelity and task return. We evaluate ReShap on Atari and Box2D

AI.title: Spec-Driven PBT: Deriving Semantic Invariants from Code Specifications for Agentic Property-based Testing
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.15920v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Software is increasingly written by AI agents that produce an implementation from a natural language specification, a practice known as agentic coding. Code is now produced faster than it can be reviewed, and has been shown to exhibit its own characteristic failure patterns. Property-based testing (PBT), a long-standing technique in which invariant properties of a program are checked against many generated inputs, has recently been revisited with LLM agents authoring the properties, thereby removing the high-effort derivation of invariants that has long hindered its adoption. Existing methods, however, derive these properties from the implementation alone (Code-driven PBT). At the same time, a thorough specification such as a product requirements document has become routine within agentic coding, yet its role in testing the resulting code remains underexplored. We study the value of the specification as a source of properties for testing agent-written code. Our key insight is that the specification, unlike the implementation, records what the code was meant to do, and invariants derived from it are not biased by particular

AI.title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.16728v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that shares manipulation structure through fine-grained, semantically corresponding observation and action modalities while keeping sensing and control interfaces embodiment-specific. EgoX pretrains a Modular Embodiment Dreamer (MED) on this mixture and fine-tunes it on target-embodiment demonstrations. Within each embodiment, MED assigns a dedicated tokenizer to each observation modality and a dedicated expert to each action modality, with a Transformer trunk shared across embodiments. A training-only embodiment-dreaming objective predicts latent representations of future visual and proprioceptive states, encouraging the shared trunk to model each embodiment's dynamics. AI.title: RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.18244v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Efficient sequential recommendation has emerged as a promising paradigm for providing real-time personalized service. To deploy models under resource-constrained environment, model compression becomes a necessity, yet existing methods typically apply uniform compression ratios, overlooking the heterogeneity in user intent complexity. This "one-size-fits-all" approach leads to a fundamental Capacity-Complexity Mismatch, where computational resources are either wasted on simple instances or insufficient for complex ones. To address this, we propose RACE (Ranking-uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation), a framework that dynamically adapts both model structures and input sequences with uncertainty-aware compression ratios. To ensure capacity-adaptive inference, RACE captures the model's intrinsic uncertainty of its predictions and transforms it into a proactive resource allocator. Specifically, we derive a list-wise ranking-uncertainty metric from the distributional stability of top-$K$ predictions, which serves as a measurable proxy for instance complexity. AI.content:
arXiv:2611.18397v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. AI.title: What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.20000v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. These findings motivate LightAlign: a few pairs let a ridge regression between two frozen encoders locate and orient the mapping simultaneously, and a classifier fitted only on report text then predicts findings from the mapped images. AI.title: Can AI Judge You? An Empirical Audit of Deployment Readiness in LLM-assisted Hiring Systems
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.20140v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Delegating resume screening to large language models (LLMs) requires organizations to establish whether they can distinguish candidates by relevant qualifications while allowing only authorized users to change screening rules or approve exceptions. To this end, we develop a system architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment record, and empirically examine two complementary dimensions of its deployment readiness. First, we assess its operational readiness on four LLMs using a controlled experiment on 210 resumes across 14 job roles and six decision interfaces. Second, we assess its compliance readiness by testing how it handles unauthorized user requests and instructions embedded in resumes. We find that operational performance depends on the choice of evaluation interface: scalar scores generally distinguish qualification changes better than simple pass/fail judgments, while comparative judgments are sensitive to presentation order. AI.title: Auditing World-Model Explanations in Retail Forecasting: Faithfulness, Accuracy and Price Response
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.20811v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Forecasting models that read the price and promotion plan explain each forecast as a baseline, what would sell with nothing planned, plus the lift the plan adds, and merchants order stock and plan promotions on that lift. We show that an explanation can pass the checks used to trust it and still be wrong enough to cost money. We define eight checks for any forecaster that states a plan lift, six with a pass rule fixed before any result, and run them on a world model and on LightGBM. In generated store data with known effects, the world model passes the checks of construction, stability, price direction and agreement with sales and with LightGBM, yet when merchants plan into high-demand weeks it states 1.33 to 1.40 times the true lift, and 1.23 to 1.42 times in eight variants of that world; LightGBM overstates it too (1.26, and 1.16 to 1.35). Both still pick the right weeks to promote, but stock ordered to the world model's lift is off by 0.44 to 0.48 of the true lift. AI.title: ProcReverser: Multi-Agent Black-Box Microarchitectural Reverse Engineering for Processor Vulnerability Analysis
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.20827v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: When processor implementation details are unavailable, black-box microarchitectural reverse engineering helps security researchers identify hardware conditions related to security vulnerabilities. However, this process requires substantial manual effort to design experiments, develop test programs, and analyze results for each processor. We present ProcReverser, a multi-agent system that automates this process. ProcReverser uses execution feedback to improve experimental plans and test programs and identifies microarchitectural properties from measurements. We develop a comprehensive suite of property identification tasks focused on hardware mechanisms relevant to Spectre-class attacks, covering speculative execution, branch prediction, memory dependence, and cache behavior. We evaluate ProcReverser on the XuanTie C910, the gem5 RISC-V O3 CPU model, and the SiFive P550. ProcReverser achieves Pass@1 and Pass@5 scores of 81.3% and 93.8%, respectively, on C910, and 83.0% and 100.0% on gem5 O3. On the SiFive P550, ProcReverser further characterizes microarchitectural properties covered by the proposed task suite. These findings

AI.title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.21001v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. AI.title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
AI.content:
arXiv:2611.21479v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Technology.title: Hydropower hit record lows in the US Southwest this summer
Technology.content: The US Southwest generated 28% less electricity via hydropower between April and August than the 10-year average, according to new data from the US Energy Information Administration. Most hydropower plants in the US rely on dams to hold back water, creating reservoirs. The water can be released through turbines, generating electricity on demand. But an extreme, prolonged drought in the Colorado River Basin has resulted in dangerously low water levels in the Southwest’s two largest reservoirs, affecting the availability of this power source. Residents and farmers in the US Southwest, a region that includes Arizona, New Mexico, and parts of Nevada and California, rely on water that melts in the spring from snowpack in the mountains and is slowly allowed to flow south via dam releases. Snowfall in the Rocky Mountains provides about 85% of the annual flow of the Colorado River . And in recent years, the river has seen record-low flows. Two reservoirs along the Colorado River, Lake Powell and Lake Mead, have struggled to stay above the minimum level required for hydropower plants. Technology.title: 日本理研系統被駭外洩註冊用戶個資、憑證，迫使超級電腦Fugaku暫停運作
Technology.content:
日本理化學研究所（理研）本周說明，理研旗下計算科學研究中心一個連結超級電腦富岳(Fugaku)的系統上周遭到未授權存取，外洩系統用戶的個資及另一臺超級電腦的存取憑證近4,597筆資料，為防事件擴大，理研也暫停了富岳的運作。
理研是在11月12日偵測到異常活動，13日確認資料可能外洩。調查確認，「富岳」超級電腦用戶的主目錄（Home Directory）中所儲存的部分檔案，以及登錄於使用者認證管理系統中的相關資訊（如SSH金鑰、存取金鑰等）可能已外流。

Technology.title: Chrome 158正式推出，修補204個資安漏洞
Technology.content: 11月17日Google發布Chrome 158穩定版更新，一口氣修補204個資安漏洞，從漏洞的嚴重程度來看，6個為重大等級、62個為高風險等級，中度及低風險分別為82個與54個。

Technology.title: Node.js修補16個漏洞，包括可能導致伺服器當機與洩漏連線資料的HTTP/2漏洞
Technology.content: 開源JavaScript執行環境專案Node.js於11月11日發布更新，涵蓋26.x、24.x與22.x等三個主要分支版本，共修補16個漏洞，其中7個為高風險漏洞，包括多項影響HTTP/2與HTTP伺服器功能的漏洞。

Technology.title: 資安署揭露某機關平臺忘記帳號功能存在身分驗證漏洞，而被新增34組異常帳號
Technology.content:
資安署每期發布的《資通安全網路月報》，都會整理政府機關近期發生的資安事件，供各機關借鏡。本週公布的115年10月月報，則檢討一起機關服務平臺資安事件，該平臺的「忘記帳號」功能存在身分驗證漏洞，系統誤判憑證驗證狀態，導致攻擊者即使未完成憑證驗證，仍能取得帳號維護權限，並進一步新增34組異常帳號。
資安署指出，這批異常帳號後續曾嘗試存取平臺其他功能，但遭到機關既有的權限存取控制機制攔阻，因此未影響平臺正常運作，也未發現功能異常或資料遭竄改、外洩等情事。本次事件影響範圍僅限於異常帳號建立，機關目前已完成漏洞修補。

Technology.title: N-able發布N-central重大安全更新，修補17個漏洞並強化身分驗證機制

Technology.content: 自10月中旬起，歐洲接連發生多起針對冷凍控制器的網路攻擊，造成食品庫存損失，甚至引發火災。荷蘭資安業者Midnight Blue近日又在Danfoss AK-SM800A冷凍控制器發現6個尚未修補漏洞，成因均為堆疊型緩衝區溢位，攻擊者不須通過身分驗證，即可能遠端執行程式碼，取得設備完整控制權。

Technology.title: Gemini對話保留期將由72小時延長為2個月
Technology.content:
Google本周透過官網及電子郵件通知用戶Gemini的一項政策變更，將切分Gemini對話記錄及AI模型許可開關，而未來Google對用戶Gemini對話的保存期間，將由現行的72小時延長為60天。
最新變更將Gemini對話紀錄和AI模型訓練的許可切分開，讓用戶可以退出生成式AI模型訓練，又能保留自己的Gemini對話紀錄，Google說這將提供用戶對Gemini對話紀錄（History）更大的控制權。

Technology.title: Redshift支援Iceberg資料表多陳述式交易，避免讀取未完成更新
Technology.content: AWS擴充資料倉儲服務Amazon Redshift對Apache Iceberg資料表的支援，現已提供多陳述式交易、自動寫入衝突解決及時間旅行查詢（Time Travel Query）。使用者可將多次資料更新合併為單一交易提交，避免分析工作讀到尚未完成的更新結果，也能查詢特定時間點的歷史資料。

Technology.content: Microsoft 365日前發生全球服務中斷，駭客隨即假借這起事故，對全球多個產業的組織發動大規模網路釣魚攻擊。微軟威脅情報團隊11月13日觀測到這波攻擊，並於16日公布調查結果。

Technology.title: AI加速嵌入式設備漏洞挖掘，研究人員90小時找出66項TCP/IP協定堆疊新漏洞
Technology.content: 網路安全業者Forescout旗下Vedere Labs近期利用現成AI模型，搭配自行開發的分析工具，針對10套嵌入式TCP/IP協定堆疊進行安全研究，在約90小時內找出99項漏洞，其中66項是這次研究新發現的漏洞，其餘33項則是過去已知的漏洞。這類協定堆疊廣泛應用於工控、醫療、網路及物聯網設備。

Technology.title: Google揭駭客利用多代理AI框架發動攻擊，另有工具可自動發掘及利用漏洞
Technology.content: 駭客已將多代理AI框架用於網路攻擊，執行系統偵察、漏洞掃描等工作，甚至建立能夠自動發掘及利用軟體漏洞的工具。Google威脅情報團隊（GTIG）近期揭露相關研究成果，指出AI代理已被用於實際入侵活動，攻擊者也開始嘗試將漏洞發掘與利用流程自動化。

「蒸餾」還是竊取智財？《路透》審閱逾 300 份文件：中國已把美國 AI 的答案做成產業流程
Technology.content: 《Reuters》11/17 獨家報導，該社審閱逾 300 份中國學術論文、專利、企業揭露資料、徵才公告與政府文件後發現，中國機構正以愈來愈精細的方式，用美國領先 AI 模型的輸出訓練本土的競爭模型；這種稱為蒸餾（distillation）的做法，已從學術實驗擴大為主流產業應用。《Reuters》分析，這可能削弱美國晶片出口管制的效果，而華府在美國時間 11/16 才表示，將進一步限制中國取得 NVIDIA 等公司的先進晶片。 蒸餾本身並不違法，在世界其他地方也很普遍。它無法複製領先模型的完整能力，也無法免除對先進算力的需求，但能把選定的技能保留在營運成本較低的小模型中，可能降低開發者對美國技術的依賴。問題在於，當其他業者的模型輸出被大量蒐集成訓練素材，技術借鑑與竊取智財間的界線該如何界分？ 美國模型解題、中國團隊留存答案：蒸餾如何從論文走進產業流程？ 蒸餾是由能力強大的「教師」模型產生答案，或示範如何完成任務，開發者再用這些輸出訓練較小的「學生」模型。一位要求匿名的阿里巴巴前工程師表示，對算力受限的中國開發者而言，蒸餾的吸引力在於讓一次昂貴的查詢反覆發揮作用：美國模型只要解答一次難題，中國團隊就能留下有用的範例，據此訓練本地系統。 《Reuters》審閱的文件顯示，蒸餾在中國已形成分工：研究人員用美國模型產生問題答案、撰寫程式碼、解決難題，企業再開發軟體把流程自動化，並由專職人員整理訓練國內小模型的素材。 上海交通大學（下稱上海交大）研究人員 2024 年底發表的論文就是一例：他們從 OpenAI 的 o1 模型挑出約 5,000 個答案，用 GPT-4o mini 翻譯，組成 10,750 筆雙語訓練範例，進一步訓練阿里巴巴的 Qwen2.5-72B 模型。《Reuters》指出，這說明美國模型的輸出可以成為可重複使用的資料，開發者不必反覆詢問原始供應商，即可改進國內系統。 阿里巴巴研究人員 2025 年的論文，則描述了更系統化的做法：先用 OpenAI 的 GPT-4 與 GPT-4o 產生中文以外語言的訓練素材，經過精煉、為回應評分後，再拿來訓練較小的 Qwen 模型。上海交大與阿里巴巴均無回應《Reuters》的置評請求。 北京沒有要求蒸餾美國模型，卻把蒸餾寫進製造業 AI 政策 文件也顯示，北京鼓勵蒸餾，好讓 AI 更便宜、更容易部署到中國強大的製造業。不過《Reuters》強調，中國政府文件並沒有指示企業蒸餾美國模型，而是把蒸餾當成推動 AI 普及全國經濟的一環。 中華人民共和國工業和信息化部（下稱中國工信部）等八個部門於 2025/12/25 發文、今年 1 月公布的《「人工智能+製造」專項行動實施意見》，在附件的製造業企業 AI 應用指南中，把蒸餾與量化、微調、訓練等工作歸給雲端，邊緣裝置則執行輕量化模型，因應工業現場的低延遲需求。政策全文

Technology.title: 「AI 要能跨部門複製與持續營運。」Dell AI 服務助企業打破 POC 負循環
Technology.content: 企業陸續建置的內部知識庫、Chatbot 或 AI Agent 等應用，如何順利融入日常工作流程並創造實際價值？Dell Technologies 服務銷售部服務業務協理劉芷伶日前在 TechOrange 科技報橘舉辦的「AI Innovation Day：2027 AI 創新日」論壇中指出，2026 年 AI 競爭的焦點，正由單點 POC 轉向平台化與持續營運，企業導入 AI 不只要證明模型做得到，更要能跨部門複製，並持續治理、優化與擴充。 劉芷伶首先分析 AI 導入遇到五大挑戰，包含：應用場景未聚焦導致難以證明商業價值、真實資料與系統流程尚未串接、缺乏可重複部署的統一平台規劃、上線後治理與維運權責不清，以及缺乏持續評測與營運機制，形成始終無法上線的 POC 負循環。 對此，Dell AI 服務推出 3 小時的「AI Advisory Workshop」互動式工作坊，協助企業找出高價值 AI 應用場景、評估 AI 成熟度，並設定可驗證的 KPI，釐清投資優先方向。劉芷伶分享，某醫院曾集結護理、藥學、影像醫學等 13 個單位參與工作坊，由第一線人員盤點出 46 個實際應用場景，涵蓋院內知識庫問答、藥品與工時統計、評鑑資料整理及個案報告生成等需求。依學員回饋推估，這些應用每週有望節省約 42 小時文書處理時間，相當於一名全職人員的週工時。「這不只是一場教育訓練，而是協助客戶用自己的真實資料，收斂出真正想解決的 AI 應用場景，」劉芷伶表示。 從初步驗證走向規模化部署，企業還需要可重複使用的共用平台架構、上線後持續監控模型與資料品質的評測機制，以及明確劃分業務、IT 與資安單位權責的治理維運模式。Dell Technologies 則透過 AI Factory 協助企業整合底層算力、儲存、網路與模型服務，並以可彈性部署於地端的企業級 AI 平台「Dobby」支援應用建置與執行，搭配貫穿專案全生命週期的 AI 治理框架，協助企業從場景驗證逐步走向正式營運。 Dobby 強化企業 AI 應用，五道治理防線確保安全可控 Dell Technologies 服務銷售部服務業務協理劉芷伶解釋企業級 AI 平台 Dobby 的架構，並提醒「選擇導入架構的關鍵，不是依公司規模，而是依資料量、協作需求、工作複雜度與治理要求。」 Dell Technologies 服務銷售部服務業務協理劉芷伶解釋企業級 AI 平台 Dobby 的架構，並提醒「選擇導入架構的關鍵，不是依公司規模，而是依資料量、協作需求、工作複雜度與治理要求。」 Dobby 支援地端部署，讓企業能在內部環境直接整合 AI 運算設備、自有文件與開源模型，進行知識檢索或模型微調，確保核心數據不外流，適用於資料敏感度高、監管嚴格，或擁有大量專屬技術文件與跨系統作業需求的場景。例如醫療院所的病歷查詢與健保申報核刪、電信與製

Technology.title: 黃仁勳請辭後，NVIDIA 新設國安與出口管制委員會：美方追查的新加坡轉運漏洞怎麼來？
Technology.content: NVIDIA 共同創辦人黃仁勳因私人關係引發國安疑慮後，於美國時間 11/12 辭去總裁、執行長與董事職務。不到一週，NVIDIA 董事會 11/17 宣布成立常設的「國家安全與出口管制監督委員會」。《Reuters》指出，這是黃仁勳離職後，NVIDIA 的第一項重大治理調整；國會議員也準備詢問曾力推擴大對中國出口晶片的黃仁勳。 不過據《CNN》報導，也有官員認為外界聚焦黃仁勳與中國政府的關係，反而模糊了更大的問題：美國政府未能有效遏止 AI 競賽關鍵技術轉運中國。當 NVIDIA 把出口管制合規拉到董事會層級，晶片經新加坡等第三地轉運中國的疑慮，又是從哪些漏洞形成的？ NVIDIA 新委員會管什麼？國安與貿易合規團隊直接向委員會匯報 根據 NVIDIA 官方新聞稿，新委員會負責在董事會層級監督公司的國安政策、出口管制合規與全球貿易風險管理，由董事 Suzanne Nora Johnson 擔任主席，董事 Stephen C. Neal、John O. Dabiri 為委員。委員會至少每季開會一次，包括不含管理階層的執行會議（executive session），並將聘請獨立的外部專家，提供法律、國安與貿易合規的專業意見。 匯報線也跟著調整：既有的國安團隊與全球貿易合規團隊，日常營運將直接向委員會及代理執行長 Colette Kress 匯報；Kress 為財務長，黃仁勳請辭後兼任代理執行長。董事長 Harvey Jones 在新聞稿中表示，NVIDIA 認知到先進晶片技術與人工智慧、超級智慧的出現，「為國家安全帶來前所未有的挑戰」，NVIDIA「既有責任，也有機會引領產業」。 帳單在新加坡、晶片卻未必運抵：轉售與遠端租用兩條路徑 《CNBC》報導，NVIDIA 與新加坡相關的營收占比，在截至 2025 年 7 月那一季升至 22%，2023 年只有 8%；新加坡貿工部則估計，實際運抵當地的晶片不到 NVIDIA 營收的 1%。據《Bloomberg》報導，NVIDIA 過去依客戶的帳單地點統計地區營收，後來改依直接客戶的總部所在地統計，新加坡營收因此小到被併入其他類別。作為主要帳單地與潛在轉運樞紐，新加坡正受到美方檢視；美國官員稱，有 NVIDIA 晶片已流入中國。 《CNBC》整理出兩條繞過管制的路徑。第一條是實體轉售：NVIDIA 晶片可以合法賣給馬來西亞、新加坡等國的客戶，再被非法轉售或轉出口到中國。第二條是遠端租用：中國企業不必直接購買硬體，也能合法遠端使用中國境外資料中心裡最先進的 AI 晶片。前者涉及非法轉出口，後者在美國新規推出前並不違法。 AI 風險評估公司 Lyvi 研究主管 Alvin Camba 對《CNBC》指出，新加坡當局承認，貿易流與金流分開監控之間可能存在「盲點」；他也表示，新加坡嚴格的公司保密規定保障外國投資人，但也可能讓外

Technology.title: 微軟押注「小而專」AI 模型，稱 MAI Code 2 以 5% 成本達 Claude Opus 5.5 的 96% 效能
Technology.content: 微軟（Microsoft）近日在年度技術大會 Ignite 上，發表一系列專用 AI 模型，涵蓋程式開發、資安與影像生成，《Decrypt》形容這是直接向 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 叫陣。微軟並非要打造一款樣樣都贏的聊天機器人，而是主打針對特定工作訓練的模型，以大幅降低的成本完成任務。 微軟董事長暨執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）在開幕演講中表示：「對我們來說，重點是以最佳的經濟效益，將合適的智慧對應到特定任務。」他指出，自家 MAI 模型家族在預訓練階段講求運算效率，產品部署時則講求 token 效率，目標是依據實際任務表現，在前沿曲線上補上更多選擇。 這次最大膽的宣稱來自 MAI Code 2。微軟表示，這款程式碼模型在常見企業程式開發任務上的表現，可達 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Opus 5.5 的 96%，成本卻只有後者的 5%；與 OpenAI 的 GPT-6.1 Sol 相比，能以 40% 的價格達到 98% 的效能。但 OpenAI 同一天推出 GPT-6.2，微軟拿來比較的 GPT-6.1 Sol 已非最新一代。納德拉形容，MAI Code 2 是微軟新的旗艦代理式程式開發模型家族，擅長將程式碼推進到正式上線、深度除錯、多檔案實作、橫跨整個程式庫的推理，以及使用者介面開發。 上述數字是四項聚焦實際軟體開發的評測平均，包括修正程式碼與完成跨檔案修改等任務。其中三項在微軟自家的評估平台上進行，另一項採用外部結果；微軟計算 MAI Code 2 的成本時，也套用了 50% 的促銷折扣。 微軟同時推出較輕量的 MAI Code 2 Flash，鎖定程式碼解說、針對性修改、例行修正與快速迭代等需要快速、大量處理的工作，並宣稱效能與 Claude Haiku 5.5 相當，價格卻只有後者的 20%。兩款程式碼模型都已在 GitHub Copilot 全面開放，可從模型選單中選用，也已納入 Copilot Fusion，另可透過 Foundry 平台取得；《Decrypt》指出，這讓微軟自研技術直接進入一款高度仰賴外部 AI 供應商的產品。 資安模型每項任務成本不到 GPT-6 Astra 的 2%，「小而專」策略仍有取捨 資安是微軟的另一個主攻方向。微軟表示，MAI Cyber 2 Flash 在 CyberGym-E2E 評測中，成功完成 92.3% 的漏洞探索任務，略高於 OpenAI 旗下 GPT-6 Astra 的 91.5%，每項任務的成本卻不到後者的 2%。CyberGym-E2E 衡量的是 AI 成功完成軟體安全調查的比例；微軟發現 905 項任務中有 92 項的來源資料與訓練資料重疊，因此將這些任務排除。 微軟尚未公布 MAI Cyber 2 Flash 與 OpenAI 限制存取的 GPT-6 Cyb

Technology.title: 【個人 AI 代理還進不了公司】資安與成本風險未解，企業版代理人才是可行路徑
Technology.content: AI 代理人已經能替使用者處理生活瑣事，甚至代為議價、談方案。但當員工想把同樣的工具帶進公司，連上工作信箱與企業系統，問題就沒那麼簡單。 個人代理人與聊天機器人有本質差異 Muse、Instinct，以及 ChatGPT 開發商 OpenAI 推出的 Dots 等個人代理人，有潛力徹底改變人們與各種系統互動的方式，不論是消費或商業用途。 客服軟體公司 Zendesk 執行長 Tom Eggemeier 近期受訪時就分享，社群平台巨頭 Meta 推出的個人代理人 Muse，5 天內幫他省下 3,105 美元；Muse 替他重新協商家中的網路、電視與手機方案，完成約 95% 的工作，最後只留下一通電話讓他自己打。 乍看之下，個人代理人只是 ChatGPT 這類對話式 AI 的下一步。兩者確實有共同的基礎，包括強大的對話與推理能力、會隨時間改善的記憶，以及能串接其他應用程式、提升生產力並補充情境的工具。 但個人代理人有一項聊天機器人缺乏的關鍵特性，就是始終在線，並代表使用者行動。 它為個人服務，對使用者及其生活有一致的理解，更接近一種關係。它會逐漸了解使用者、提出意見、全天候執行指令，更重要的是，它會主動發起對話，而不是等待使用者下指令。 這種主動性，遠遠超出目前最強大的生成式聊天介面所能做到的事。使用者也需要一段時間，才能適應代理人逐漸替自己分擔的工作。 直接引進企業，資安與成本都有風險 然而，讓個人代理人存取工作信箱、Microsoft 365，或任何 SaaS（雲端訂閱軟體）與自主商業應用，風險相當高。這些產品太新，還沒有取得企業倚賴的各項標準，例如服務組織資安控管稽核標準 SOC 2、資訊安全管理國際標準 ISO 27001，以及 AI 管理系統國際標準 ISO 42001，也難以證明在企業環境中符合歐盟《一般資料保護規則》（GDPR）。 此外，個人代理人的設計本來就仰賴跨系統的資料，才能了解使用者、提升效率，因此很難承諾不拿資料訓練或保留資料。一旦連上企業系統，它就成為資料次處理者，也就是代企業處理資料的第三方，資安團隊將有許多事情需要解釋。 成本則是最少被討論的風險。聊天機器人只在有人輸入時才產生費用，始終在線的代理人卻不論有沒有人看都持續運作。它會頻繁檢查是否有新任務，每次都把對話紀錄與其他情境送進模型，還能自行產生輔助代理人。OpenAI 已經在描述多個 Dots 協同工作的未來，而每一個代理人，都是另一支持續跳動的計費表。 事實上，成本失控的跡象已經出現。叫車平台 Uber 在 4 月就花光了 2026 年全年的 AI 程式開發預算；線上旅遊平台 Priceline 續約 AI 程式開發工具時，價格變成原本的 4 至 5 倍；推動雲端財務營運管理的 FinOps 基金會也表示，到了今年春季，企業回報的 token 支出已達年度預算的 3 倍。 企

Technology.title: ChatGPT 推薦後的品牌造訪，僅 8.8% 從 AI 點擊進站：IAB「歸因藍圖」先定義誰能爭功
Technology.content: 美國互動廣告局（IAB）於美國時間 11/12 發布《AI 時代歸因藍圖》（AI-Era Attribution Blueprint），指出 AI 涉入的成交沒有從報表上消失，而是常被記到錯的來源。IAB 在報告中引用 Similarweb 的追蹤數據，收到 ChatGPT 品牌推薦的美國桌機用戶，之後 7 天內造訪該品牌網站的流量，只有 8.8% 是從 AI 點擊進站，過半仍來自搜尋。 歸因（attribution）是判斷一筆成交的功勞（credit）該算在哪個廣告或管道頭上，也決定下一筆預算投向哪裡。身為美國數位廣告產業的主要公會，IAB 要怎麼重新定義 AI 在一筆成交中的角色？誰有資格爭功，又要拿出什麼證據？ AI 涉入的業績沒有消失，而是被記到搜尋與直接流量上 藍圖工作小組由 IAB 人工智慧副總裁 Caroline Giegerich 帶領，成員包括 Walmart、WPP Media、Microsoft、Criteo，以及 Brandlight 等 AI 能見度業者。Giegerich 表示：「隨著 AI 接手更多購買旅程，從引發興趣到完成交易，歸因所依賴的點擊與引薦正在變少或消失。」購買旅程指的是消費者從產生興趣、研究比較到完成購買的整個過程。Giegerich 指出，受 AI 左右的銷售有時被記成搜尋或直接流量，可能讓下一筆行銷投資投錯管道。 IAB 也坦言，歸因本來就無法完整呈現購買旅程，訊號流失、封閉平台與線下行為等問題都早於 AI 出現；AI 是暴露並延伸了既有問題：過去散在多個可追蹤網頁的研究與比較，現在可能在一段對話內完成。 至於 Similarweb 的 8.8% 數據，來自 2025 年 7–12 月，涵蓋金融、旅遊、美妝三個產業，並排除提問時已提到品牌、或前 4 週造訪過品牌網站的用戶。結果顯示，收到推薦的用戶 7 天內造訪被推薦品牌的機率，是未被推薦競品的 2.5 倍；推薦後的造訪中，55.9% 來自搜尋，沒有收到推薦的造訪則有 40.4% 來自搜尋。Similarweb 本身也販售生成式 AI 能見度與流量的分析服務。 三個問題、三類路徑：成交當下，誰創造意圖、誰做決定、誰完成交易？ 藍圖在成交當下問三個問題：誰（人或 AI）創造了意圖、誰做了決定、誰執行了交易。IAB 強調，這些問題用來分類角色，不代表需求只有單一成因；AI 在購物過程中可能扮演多種角色，但每筆轉換（conversion，完成購買等目標行為）只依成交當下的角色，歸入一條路徑（pathway）。 人類主導（Human-Owned）是三個角色都由人擔任。過程中即使用了搜尋或 AI，只要 AI 沒有接手這些角色，仍屬人類主導，例如消費者決定回購同款跑鞋，只問 AI 新版尺寸準不準。另一端是 AI 執行（AI-Executed），由 AI 代為完成交易。 介於

Technology.title: 巨輪興業攜手台達打造高彈性、高整合、高擴充數位製造架構
Technology.content: 一輛救護車從街上疾駛而過，車頂閃爍的警示燈與警報器，提醒周遭用路人注意、及時讓道，這是多數人再熟悉不過的情境。但鮮少有人注意的是，這些看似規格明確的車用設備，會因不同國家的法規、車種與使用情境而有不同需求。位於新北土城的巨輪興業(以下簡稱巨輪)工廠，組裝產線換線頻率高，正反映出警示設備少量多樣的產業特性。 PCBA 轉向自主製造 帶動巨輪新一波數位管理升級 成立於 1990 年的巨輪，長期深耕車用電子與安全警示系統，產品涵蓋警示燈、警報器及整車控制系統，應用於警車、消防車、救護車及其他特殊用途車輛。產品以銷往海外為主，市場遍及歐美、澳洲、中東與日本；因應各國法規、車種與使用情境差異，產品組合高度多樣化。 近年巨輪逐步擴大自主製造，建置 SMT (表面貼裝) 與 DIP (雙列式封裝零件安裝) 產線，將原本委外的 PCBA 轉為自製。巨輪副總經理陳世佑表示，會有此策略，主要是考量交期、成本與開發速度，「過去 PCBA 委外打件通常需要兩至三週，自製後可依訂單彈性安排生產、降低半成品庫存，新品打樣也能利用廠內設備完成，大幅縮短開發時間。」 不過把 PCBA 製程帶回廠內，也意味著巨輪需要掌握更多製造環節。陳世佑指出，近年海外客戶對生產資訊的要求也愈來愈細，例如歐洲市場重視產品追溯，日本客戶則希望可回查生產時間與使用物料，這些要求都需要有更完整的製造紀錄。SMT 與 DIP 產線加入後，印刷機、貼片機、AOI等自動化設備也會產出大量製程資料，如何將新增製程、設備與生產資料納入既有製造管理體系，成為 PCBA 自製後的新挑戰。為解決此問題，巨輪攜手台達，推動新一波轉型。 「過去 PCBA 委外打件通常需要兩至三週，自製後可依訂單彈性安排生產、降低半成品庫存，新品打樣也能利用廠內設備完成，大幅縮短開發時間。」巨輪興業副總經理陳世佑表示。 台達情境式導入 讓製造管理延伸至新製程 雙方在 PCBA 自製之前就已開始合作，在台達協助下，巨輪過去陸續導入 MES 與 WMS，整合組裝生產與倉儲管理。此次 PCBA 製程移回廠內，新增自動化設備並擴增SMT、DIP產線，進一步擴大製造範圍。 陳世佑提到，製造系統導入後需要長期融入日常營運，因此除了產品功能，供應商的溝通、整合與落地能力同樣重要，「我們很重視彈性，系統必須能配合實際需求做調整。」他強調，每家工廠的產品與製程不同，現場需求也會持續變化，在雙方過去的合作過程中，從需求溝通、系統整合到現場導入，台達展現專業能力且溝通順暢，也成為巨輪繼續與台達合作的重要考量。 面對巨輪製造範圍的擴充，以及 PCBA 自製帶來的新製程與設備，台達此次採取「情境式導入」策略。雙方先梳理需求，再決定需要哪些模組與功能。台達機電事業群智能製造軟體新事業發展部處長陳鴻輝指出，製造現場牽涉生產、設備、物料與在製品等不同環節，「我們會先了解客戶實際的管

Technology.title: 【劉永信專欄】11/18 飛出人類第一個「一光日」，為什麼你該認識這艘最孤獨太空船？
Technology.content: 對很多人來說，11 月 18 日沒有什麼特殊的意義。但就在今年的 11 月 18 日，一艘 1977 年發射的太空船，成為人類史上第一個距離地球「一光日」（Light-day）的物體。 一光日，大概是 259 億公里，是光走一天的距離。「航海家 1 號」這艘太空船整整飛了 49 年又 2 個月。當年 NASA 給它的任務是飛過木星和土星，拍照、傳資料回來；而當時的工程師在設計時，想的是在沒人能上太空維修的情況下，怎麼讓它撐過幾十年？ 就在大家快忘記它的這個時候，我想特別寫一篇文章，跟大家聊聊它真正為人類帶來的創舉是什麼。我覺得，在這個技術每天都在翻新、逼著所有人把事情「做快」的時代，我越來越相信，在很多決策的思考核心裡，其實有很多事情比「快」更重要。 從早期經歷網路泡沫，這二十幾年一路走到現在的 AI 轉型，我每天跟研發團隊拉鋸的課題，說穿了就是資源怎麼分配、毛利撐不住的業務什麼時候砍、為了趕上線欠下的技術債未來怎麼還。 做這些決定的過程，就像這艘 1977 年的太空船的一生一樣，在浩瀚無垠的宇宙裡孤獨前行，堅持完成任務，我從這艘太空船上，看到了一些答案也想在 11 月 18 日這天跟大家分享。 拍完最紅的「暗淡藍點」後，為什麼 NASA 要關掉最重要的相機功能？ 1990 年 2 月 14 日，航海家 1 號在距離地球約 60 億公里之外，拍下了一張地球的照片。這張照片後來成了天文史上最著名的「暗淡藍點」（Pale Blue Dot），但很多人不知道的是，拍完這張全世界最紅的照片之後，工程師立刻把它的相機永久關掉了。 圖片來源： https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1s-pale-blue-dot/ 。 為什麼不讓航海家 1 號繼續工作？其實原因很簡單，一號飛得太遠了，太陽能板根本派不上用場，它靠的是核電池，利用放射性物質衰變產生的熱來發電，而這種電力每年都在減少，1977 年發射時可以供應 470 瓦，現在只剩不到一半。過去幾十年為了省電，團隊陸續關掉了六項科學儀器，它發射時總共帶了十項科學儀器，才一路撐到今天。 在資源充沛的時候，每個人都會做加法，但當大環境變冷、資源開始緊縮時，真正的考驗才開始，你敢不敢為了讓核心任務活下去，親手關掉那個曾經最風光、最吸引眼球、但已經不再符合當前階段目標的功能？ 取捨從來不是技術問題，我才發現，在限制裡做選擇、忍痛砍掉非必要功能，在每個偉大的專案，包括航海家 1 號裡都是一定要面對到的事。 我在 2000 年網路泡沫學到的第一課 1998 年我加入蕃薯藤是第 007 號員工，那時候沒有雲端、沒有開發框架，那時剛好遇到 1999 年 921 大地震，當時一個朋友聯繫不上她家裡的人，於是我和創辦人討論之後，那幾天趕出一套線上刷卡捐款系統，在幾天內就募到了八百多萬

Technology.title: 【科技早餐】加州起訴 OpenAI！檢方指 AI 代理測試至少 80 次失控
Technology.content: 【科技早餐】今天精選 7 則國內外重要科技新聞。 ＊OpenAI 遭加州起訴，AI 代理安全責任走上法庭 美國加州檢察長邦塔（Rob Bonta）11 月 16 日向舊金山州法院起訴 OpenAI，指控公司在研發與測試自主 AI 代理時，缺乏足夠安全防護與監控，涉嫌違反加州《不公平競爭法》及造成公共危害。檢方以今年 7 月 Hugging Face 平台遭實驗性代理入侵為例，並稱 OpenAI 在測試期間至少 80 次失去對自主代理的控制。檢方要求法院介入安全管理並追究相關責任；這些指控尚未經法院認定。 這起案件把 AI 代理可能造成的外部損害，從技術風險推向法律責任。當 AI 能操作瀏覽器、呼叫工具及接觸外部系統，企業除了任務完成率，還須評估權限邊界、測試隔離、異常中止與操作紀錄。OpenAI 表示已公開事件調查、通知相關單位並加強防護，也質疑訴訟只針對單一業者。雙方說法仍待司法程序檢驗，後續可能影響 AI 代理的部署審查與產品責任標準。 ＊軟銀退出 Boston Dynamics：現代汽車迎戰 Atlas 量產與虧損考驗 韓國《Financial News》11 月 17 日依現代 Glovis 第 3 季報告指出，現代汽車集團相關股東已在第 3 季完成收購軟銀持有的 Boston Dynamics 最後 9.65% 股權。股份由集團關係企業、董事長鄭義宣等既有股東承接，合計持有全部股份，並非現代汽車單一法人持股 100%。其中現代 Glovis 的持股由第 2 季末 11.39% 提高至第 3 季末 12.47%。 現代汽車早已規劃 2028 年建立年產最高 3 萬台機器人的製造能力，並讓 Atlas 先在美國喬治亞州工廠執行零件排序，2030 年再逐步擴及組裝。這些仍是未來目標，並非已完成量產。依韓媒引述季報，Boston Dynamics 前三季營收約 1,360 億韓元，淨虧損約 6,266 億韓元。股權整合有利統籌投資，但成本、安全可靠度與外部客戶需求，才是人形機器人能否建立可持續商業模式的關鍵。 ＊OpenAI 向 TensorWave 訂購 457 MW AMD 算力，簽 6 年合約 美國 AI 雲端業者 TensorWave 11 月 16 日宣布，與 OpenAI 簽訂 6 年專用算力協議，將在美國多座資料中心提供合計 457 MW 的 IT 設備容量，採用 AMD Instinct MI455X GPU 和 Helios 機櫃架構。首批預計 2027 年上半年運作，整體部署目標為 2028 年初；合約金額未公布。這是 OpenAI 與 AMD 既有合作後，新增具名雲端營運商及交付時程的具體進展。 這筆交易讓 NVIDIA 之外的算力選擇更具體，也反映大型模型業者正透過專用雲端業者分散硬體來源與部署風險。晶片效能之外，資料中心能否取得電
